description:
Facing eviction due to unpaid rent, Park Seong-ho, a struggling young man, receives a shocking offer from his landlady, Lee Seo-yoon. “If you do as I say… I’ll forget about the rent.” A humiliating contract begins. Yet as power and desire intertwine, their relationship starts to spiral in an increasingly unpredictable direction…

**Original Webtoon:**
